# TAKE 1 SHIPPED THREE CUTS INSIDE A WORD AND THE EDGE SWEEP PASSED ALL THREE.
# That is a limit of the sweep, not a bug in it: its test is that a cut lands at
# a dip, and a breath inside a word IS a dip. "un|fair" has a 140ms one, "i|dea"
# has 70ms, and "meatb--" is a 100ms burst of its own. Reading the dip LIST is
# not enough; the envelope SHAPE has to be read, because a word end falls and
# stays down while a breath dips and climbs straight back into the same word.
# 07198 was struck on Master's ruling, not on audio: lines that assume he is
# Revan do not transfer, and he has no pupil.
